headline: President Bush changed the list of officials who would step in to run the Department of Agriculture if top leaders cannot serve.
what_it_does: This order updates the Department of Agriculture's order of succession. That is the ranked list of officials who would act as Secretary of Agriculture if the Secretary and other top leaders die, resign, or are otherwise unable to do the job. The title does not say which officials were added, removed, or moved on the list.

who_it_affects.group: Senior officials at the Department of Agriculture
who_it_affects.how: Their place in line to temporarily lead the department may have changed.
